<section class="gy-plant-section light">

  <div class="gy-plant-inner">

    <div class="gy-section-heading">

      <span class="gy-section-label">
        What I’ve Observed
      </span>

      <h2>
        Lessons That Keep Showing Up
      </h2>

      <p>
        These should stay high-level and observational. The goal is to share
        what the journey has revealed without turning the page into the full
        growing system that could eventually become part of paid education.
      </p>

    </div>


    <div class="gy-observation-grid">

      <article class="gy-observation-card">
        <h3>Tree Age Matters</h3>
        <p>
          Young mango trees and more established trees can respond very
          differently to the same Phoenix conditions.
        </p>
      </article>

      <article class="gy-observation-card">
        <h3>Every Season Adds Context</h3>
        <p>
          One hot summer or one cold winter is only one chapter. The longer
          these trees are documented, the more useful the story becomes.
        </p>
      </article>

      <article class="gy-observation-card">
        <h3>Location Changes the Experience</h3>
        <p>
          Trees growing only a short distance apart can experience noticeably
          different conditions within the same food forest.
        </p>
      </article>

    </div>

  </div>

</section>
